policy: Same ordered scenarios for every configuration. Fresh browser context per scenario, navigation +1s settling; never inject state or adjust paths based on candidate play. Same blocked network, clock modes, viewport and host deadlines. Timed path failures alone are not candidate defects; missed encounters remain NOT_REACHED. Candidate reset button unavailable/covered recorded as candidate evidence, capture/runtime infrastructure problems as EVALUATOR_ERROR.
